flagRule: Primary flag when the correct option is more than 8 characters longer than the median of the three distractors or when total option-length spread exceeds 15 characters.

revisedOptions: Use a different warm-up, time, or start procedure before the final

sourcesInspected: World Physiotherapy, Policy statement: Evidence-based practice (June 2023), PS-EBP: evidence-informed interpretation and decision-making
